name: ultra-config
description: A designed /config: five one-press profiles (Token saver, Fast flow, Max quality, Guarded, Autopilot) that set Claude Code up for one way of working, with a preview of every change and undo, plus the whole settings menu as a categorized form with search. /config rows are written the way the menu writes them; effort, subagent model, env caps and deny rules go to ~/.claude/settings.json after a backup copy.

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (44-100); a width you drag it to wins
